"""Boundary/limit tests: sizes, nesting depth, extremes, performance."""
import json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import run_raw, run, Checks, prof, query, rec

c = Checks()
ERR = b'{"error":"invalid-input"}\n'

sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
import main as M

def depth_ok(text):
    return M.nesting_within_limit(text.encode() if isinstance(text, str) else text)

c.check('depth 1', depth_ok('{"zones":[],"profiles":[],"queries":[],"observations":[]}'))
c.check('depth 4', depth_ok('{"a":[{"b":1}]}'))
c.check('depth 6', depth_ok('{"a":[{"b":[{"c":1}]}]}'))
c.check('depth 31 allowed', depth_ok('[' * 31 + ']' * 31))
c.check('depth 32 allowed', depth_ok('[' * 32 + ']' * 32))
c.check('depth 33 rejected', not depth_ok('[' * 33 + ']' * 33))
c.check('depth 33 mixed rejected',
        not depth_ok('{"z":' + '[' * 30 + '{' * 2 + '}' * 2 + ']' * 30 + '}'))
c.check('brackets inside strings ignored',
        depth_ok('{"o":[{"owner":"[[[[[[.","type":"TXT","data":"}}}}}}"}]}]'))
c.check('escaped quote in string', depth_ok('{"a":"b\\"c[["}'))
c.check('escaped backslash', depth_ok('{"a":"\\\\"}'))
c.check('unbalanced rejected', not depth_ok('[[[}]]'))
c.check('utf-8 escapes with brackets', depth_ok('{"a":"\\u00e4\\u00e5[[["}'))

# ---- 8 MiB boundary
LIMIT = 8 * 1024 * 1024
head = ('{"zones":[],"profiles":[{"id":"p","max_aliases":4,"cname":"follow",'
        '"wildcard":"rfc"}],"queries":[],"observations":')
core = head + '[]}'
doc_ok = (head + ' ' * (LIMIT - len(core)) + '[]}').encode()
assert len(doc_ok) == LIMIT, (len(doc_ok), LIMIT)
rc, out, err = run_raw(doc_ok)
c.check('exactly 8MiB valid', rc == 0 and out.startswith(b'{"runs":'), '%r %r %r' % (rc, out[:60], err[:200]))
rc, out, err = run_raw(doc_ok + b' ')
c.check('8MiB + 1 rejected', rc == 0 and out == ERR, '%r %r' % (rc, out[:60]))

# ---- big valid document, timed
big_txt = 'z' * 256
zones = [{'origin': 'z%d.test.' % zi, 'records': [
    rec('o%d.z%d.test.' % (oi, zi), 'TXT', big_txt) for oi in range(63)] +
    [rec('*.z%d.test.' % zi, 'CNAME', 'end.z0.test.')]} for zi in range(16)]
c.check('zone record budget exactly 1024', sum(len(z['records']) for z in zones) == 1024,
        sum(len(z['records']) for z in zones))
observations = [{'id': 'o%d' % oi, 'query': 'q0', 'profile': 'p%d' % (oi % 8),
                 'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                            'answer': [rec('x%d.y.z.example.' % j, 'TXT', big_txt)
                                       for j in range(128)]}} for oi in range(64)]
doc = {'zones': zones,
       'profiles': [prof('p%d' % i, 64, 'follow', 'rfc') for i in range(8)],
       'queries': [query('q%d' % qi, 'w%d.test.' % qi, 'A', qi + 1) for qi in range(20)],
       'observations': observations}
raw = json.dumps(doc, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
print('large document bytes: %d' % len(raw))
t0 = time.time()
rc, out, err = run_raw(raw)
elapsed = time.time() - t0
c.check('large document accepted', rc == 0 and out.startswith(b'{"runs":'), '%r %s %s' % (rc, out[:60], err[:200]))
parsed = json.loads(out) if out.startswith(b'{"runs') else None
c.check('large doc output bytes sane', out is not None and len(out) < 32 << 20, len(out) if out else None)
print('elapsed for large document: %.2fs  output %d bytes' % (elapsed, len(out)))
if parsed is not None:
    c.check('large document runs 160', len(parsed['runs']) == 160, len(parsed['runs']))
    c.check('large document audits 64', len(parsed['audits']) == 64, len(parsed['audits']))

# same document but padded with whitespace to nearly 8 MiB
pad = ('\n' * 200 + ' ' * 900) + ''
padded = (json.dumps(doc, indent=0).encode())
# inject large whitespace runs to stress the scanner with a near-capacity input
big_pad = b' ' * (LIMIT // 2)
raw_padded = padded[:0] + b'{"zones":[]' + big_pad + b',' + b'"profiles":[]' + b',' + b'"queries":[]' + b',' + b'"observations":[]' + b'}'
try:
    json.loads(raw_padded.decode())
    print('pad document unexpectedly valid json')
except Exception as exc:
    c.check('pad document is invalid json (expected)', 'Expecting' in str(exc))

# ---- name length extremes
name63 = 'a' * 63
c.check('three 63-char labels ok', M.canon_name('.'.join([name63] * 3) + '.') == '.'.join([name63] * 3) + '.')
wire255 = '.'.join([name63] * 3 + ['a' * 61]) + '.'
c.check('wire length exactly 255 ok', M.canon_name(wire255) == wire255)
wire256 = '.'.join([name63] * 3 + ['a' * 62]) + '.'
try:
    M.canon_name(wire256); c.check('wire length 256 rejected', False)
except M.Invalid:
    c.check('wire length 256 rejected', True)
c.check('txt 256 accepted', M.canon_txt_data('q' * 256) == 'q' * 256)
try:
    M.canon_txt_data('q' * 257); c.check('txt 257 rejected', False)
except M.Invalid:
    c.check('txt 257 rejected', True)

# ---- exactly 1024 records in one zone, at most 64 distinct per RRset
zone = {'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('r.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.%d' % (i % 64))
                                     for i in range(1024)]}
p0 = {'id': 'p', 'max_aliases': 0, 'cname': 'follow', 'wildcard': 'rfc'}
got = run({'zones': [zone], 'profiles': [p0], 'queries': [], 'observations': []})
if got[0] == 0 and got[1].startswith(b'{"runs'):
    parsed = json.loads(got[1])
    c.check('1024 records / 64 distinct ok', parsed['runs'] == [], got[1][:80])
else:
    c.check('1024 records / 64 distinct ok', False, got[1][:80])
# a 64-hop CNAME chain with max_aliases = 64 (exactly at the cap)
chain = [{'origin': 'test.',
          'records': [rec('n%d.test.' % i, 'CNAME', 'n%d.test.' % (i + 1)) for i in range(64)] +
                  [rec('n64.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.64')]}]
docs = {'zones': chain,
        'profiles': [prof('pa', 64), prof('pb', 63)],
        'queries': [query('qc', 'n0.test.', 'A', 1)],
        'observations': []}
got = run(docs)
if got[0] == 0 and got[1].startswith(b'{"runs'):
    parsed = json.loads(got[1])
    terms = {r['profile']: (r['termination'], len(r['answer'])) for r in parsed['runs']}
    c.check('64 aliases reach the terminal RRset',
            terms['pa'] == ('ANSWER', 65), terms.get('pa'))
    c.check('63 aliases stop one hop earlier',
            terms['pb'] == ('LIMIT', 63), terms.get('pb'))
    diag = parsed['diagnostic']
    c.check('chain cap basis cost', diag == {'equivalence': [['pa'], ['pb']],
                                            'basis': ['qc'], 'cost': 1, 'count': 1}, diag)
else:
    c.check('64 chain document valid', False, got[1][:120])

sys.exit(c.done('limit tests'))
PYEOF
